images.title: For each x, there is a y
images.alt: The universal x comes first; the existential y may depend on x.
images.caption: Recorded Definograph quantifier-flow view from this Lean source. This focused view shows quantifier order and permitted dependence between the displayed binders; it does not provide a witness or proof.
images.explanationHtml: For each x, y is introduced inside x’s scope. The choice of y may depend on x.
images.sourceCode: example : Prop := ∀ x : Nat, ∃ y : Nat, y = x

images.title: One y for every x
images.alt: The existential y comes first; the later universal x cannot change that choice.
images.caption: Recorded Definograph quantifier-flow view from this Lean source. This focused view shows quantifier order and permitted dependence between the displayed binders; it does not provide a witness or proof.
images.explanationHtml: Here y is introduced before x. The same y is required to work for every x.
images.sourceCode: example : Prop := ∃ y : Nat, ∀ x : Nat, y = x
